// A buffer read twice with different sampler settings.
// Left half: Buffer A tiled 4x4 (wrap=repeat, filter=mipmap, so the small copies stay smooth).
// Right half: the same buffer with default settings (clamp), so beyond the first copy
// it smears into flat bands.
// ==== Buffer A ====
void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = fragCoord / iResolution.xy;
    float d = length(uv - 0.5);
    fragColor = vec4(vec3(step(d, 0.3)) * vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.1), 1.0);   // orange disc on black
}
// ==== Image ====
// glim: iChannel0 = Buffer A wrap=repeat filter=mipmap
// glim: iChannel1 = Buffer A
void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = fragCoord / iResolution.xy;
    if (uv.x < 0.5)
        fragColor = texture(iChannel0, vec2(uv.x * 2.0, uv.y) * 4.0);
    else
        fragColor = texture(iChannel1, vec2(uv.x * 2.0 - 1.0, uv.y) * 4.0);
}
